_purpose: §76 v3.2 최종 데이터 확충 재설계 사전등록 - docs/design/phase8-blue-green-preflight-incident.md §76과 동일 내용, 기계 판독용.

v31_rejected_model_preserved.status: v3.1 rejected model - permanently preserved, never modified or overwritten

development_history.why_eligible_as_v32_training: all 6 sessions passed real SLO/safety validity checks (§66/¡70) - being normal data is a fact independent of which v3.1 split they were originally assigned to; training only uses 'this value is known-normal', not an unseen-data guarantee.
development_history.why_not_reusable_for_v32_evaluation: the v3.1 holdout sessions already had their scores computed and reviewed in §75 (evaluation exposure) - they are no longer unseen data, so none of the 6 can serve as v3.2 calibration or holdout candidates. All v3.2 calibration/holdout sessions are freshly collected.

prospective_holdout.source: 6 newly collected sessions (holdout2-*), collected only after v3.2 freeze commit is pushed

holdout_collection_rule: collect only after v3.2_model_freeze_commit is pushed to origin; do not query model scores live during collection or abort a session based on score - only safety/SLO/cleanup validity gates collection
failure_rule: a real SLO violation or safety abnormality in any new session stops remaining collection immediately - no intensity adjustment, no result substitution; pure harness errors may be fixed and rerun under a new session_id

model_training_rules_unchanged_from_v31.feature_selection: recomputed deterministically from v3.2 Training's 6 sessions only - not copied from v3.1's result; exact zero variance removed, near-zero reported only, calibration/holdout never used
model_training_rules_unchanged_from_v31.algorithm: IsolationForest(n_estimators=100, contamination='auto', random_state=42), no hyperparameter search
model_training_rules_unchanged_from_v31.threshold_selection: replay.calibrate_threshold() on the new Calibration 6 sessions only - most sensitive threshold with 0 false signal episodes across all 6

must_document_diff_from_v31: feature selection result identical or different
artifact_freeze.reproducibility_check: 3 independent retrainings, byte-identical verification (same procedure as §74.4)

stop_loss_rule.trigger: 1 or more false signal episodes across the 6 prospective holdout sessions
on_trigger: holdout not folded into calibration/training to spin up a v3.3 attempt
record that Isolation Forest has not achieved operational reliability with the current data and structure
propose (do not execute) adjustments to the main-experiment design/framing, then stop
stop_loss_rule.on_pass: model_adopted=true, proceed to one-time boundary challenge evaluation

boundary_challenge_gate: only evaluated if prospective holdout passes; scored exactly once; results never used to adjust threshold/feature/model
scope_limits: no score_server.py runtime change or deployment
no readjustment based on holdout results
